closure_policy.scope: Five canonical scenario playback adapters, eight deployment historical CLI replays, FastAPI factory/lifespan, health and scenario catalog; readiness requires verification of the entire explicit runtime set and tracked science authorities.
closure_policy.version_relationship: v2 supersedes D1 only for deployment bundle construction; D1 remains the unchanged historical five-scenario audit authority.
closure_policy.authorization: Every file reviewed by source dependency chain and a complete read-only discovery pass; no automatic missing-file authorization, directory wildcard, artifact generation or network retrieval.
closure_policy.isolation: Separate temporary checkout layout; only explicit runtime files copied; application sources/science documents from tracked Git files; interpreter dependencies supplied separately; developer checkout reads and offline network access denied.

tracked_build_dependencies.application_source: Tracked src/neurofly source and pyproject.toml/README.md, installed with existing Python dependencies; supplied by application build, not this data inventory.

frontend_static_assets.delivery: Tracked web/public assets, web source and package-lock.json supplied by Git/Next.js build; not part of the scientific runtime data bundle.

tracked_build_dependencies.other_dependencies: Python interpreter/installed dependencies and OS runtime files are application environment dependencies, not scientific bundle data.
